text:
marco-devx: Quick flag/behavior mismatch between REST and the Go SDK that's blocking our onboarding sample. curl to /v1/embeddings?allow_unfinished=true returns partials but Go client call with AllowUnfinished=true errors out.

elaine-sdks-go: can you paste the curl + go snippet and SDK version?

marco-devx: Go SDK v0.6.2. Repro: 
```
# REST
curl -X POST \"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings?allow_unfinished=true\" -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" -d '{"model":"tiny","inputs":["a","b","c"]}'
```
Go: 
```go
client := redwood.NewClient(os.Getenv("TOKEN"))
_, err := client.Embeddings.Create(context.Background(), redwood.EmbeddingsParams{Model: "tiny", Inputs: []string{"a","b","c"}, AllowUnfinished: true})
```
REST -> 200 with partials + per_item_errors; Go -> 400 \"unknown parameter: AllowUnfinished\".

sam-samples: our quickstart CI uses the Go client for the tutorial. This is causing new user runs to fail and blocks the onboarding flow. :grimacing:

nora-api: quick background: the batch embeddings endpoint historically only accepts allow_unfinished as a query param (snake_case). The server tolerates both snake and camel in the query parser, but we validate JSON body keys strictly and reject unknown fields. It looks like the Go serializer is putting AllowUnfinished into the JSON body instead of the query string.

elaine-sdks-go: thanks. two issues here: 1) param placement/normalization mismatch between SDK and REST for batch flags; 2) retry/backoff mismatch: REST returns an HTTP Retry-After (seconds) on 429 but the Go retryer only checked X-Retry-After-Ms so it was interpreting ms incorrectly and retrying too early. That produced repeat 429s in staging.

marco-devx: exact symptom: CI saw a flurry of 429s because the SDK retried after 100ms when server wanted 10s.

elaine-sdks-go: plan: change Go client to map known batch flags (AllowUnfinished, PartialOk) to query params (allow_unfinished, partial_ok) and accept camelCase aliases in constructors/options. Also update retry middleware to prefer Retry-After header (seconds) then fallback to X-Retry-After-Ms. Adding unit tests and a small integration smoke that runs curl vs SDK and compares status + top-level keys only.

ci-bot: New branch opened: fix/go-embeddings-flag-query-and-retry by elaine-sdks-go  CI queued.

docs-team: can we get a short changelog blurb? new users will hit the quickstart.

elaine-sdks-go: will add CHANGELOG: \"Go SDK v0.6.3: tolerate camelCase flags for batch endpoints, emit server query params for known flags, and prefer HTTP Retry-After for backoff.\" Also adding a small note in the quickstart about batch flags.

nora-api: on our side we'll keep emitting both Retry-After and X-Retry-After-Ms for one release window while clients update. Also adding a server-side test to prevent regressing body validators.

sam-samples: thanks  once merged I'll bump the sample and re-run CI. The smoke test diff will be really helpful to catch silent shape drift.

marco-devx: appreciate the quick turnaround :tada:
